title: Astroworld Album Cover
coreRelationships: The colossal golden head dominates the midground, acting as a surreal focal point and entrance.
The two children in the foreground establish a sense of scale and human interaction with the fantastical environment.
The bright blue sky and scattered popcorn create a contrast between a playful atmosphere and the underlying strangeness.
The glowing mouth of the golden head draws attention and suggests a portal or mysterious interior.
The dilapidated amusement park elements in the background add a layer of decay and a slightly unsettling mood.

Ensure the 'Parental Advisory' label is accurately placed in the bottom right.
